positions.title: Clinical Laboratory Associate
positions.description:
• Created and revised Standard Operating Procedures to accurately reflect the current workflow while adhering to Good Documentation Practice and Good Clinical Practice
• Conducted automated DNA extraction, library preparation and enrichment, and sequencing of research samples for Clinical Research and Technological Development
• Trained new hired Clinical Laboratory Scientists and Clinical Laboratory Associates on the assay workflow and equipment maintenances 
• Documented all corrective actions taken when test systems deviated from the laboratory’s established performance specifications
• Resolved nonconformance event reports to adhere to quality standards

positions.title: Clinical Laboratory Assistant
positions.description:
• Received and processed blood, saliva, and pre-extracted DNA specimens and paper
requisitions
• Oversaw Accessioning’s sample storage management, purging, and archiving responsibilities
• Resolved and documented unacceptable patient samples using Salesforce Service Cloud
and JIRA
• Trained new hires on all Accessioning SOPs

positions.title: Mathematics Tutor
positions.description:
• Worked alongside teachers to assist students with math and science
• Assigned to work closely with students who needed academic help
• Effectively raised students’ grades from F’s and D’s to B’s and A’s

volunteerExperiences.description:
San Francisco City Impact is a non-profit organization that mobilizes people to intervene through a Rescue Mission, K-8 School, Social Enterprises, Health & Wellness Center, Social Services Center, School of Ministry, Volunteer Center and an Adopt a Building initiative.

• Visited patients' homes in the underserved Tenderloin neighborhood for weekly health check-ups 
• Scheduled and coordinated follow-up appointments to maintain patient health and wellness
• Escorted sick and elderly patients to their medical appointments on and off site

• Compounded and packaged cosmetic products for a variety of conditions
• Updated and compared drug prices from different wholesalers to pull returns for future purchasing orders 
• Conducted and documented comparison of international countries banned ingredients with the pharmacy’s cosmetic product ingredients

projects.title: Etzieees
projects.description:
Tribute to the E-commerce website Etsy.com, which focuses on handmade or vintage items and craft supplies

 Ruby on Rails | PostgreSQL | React | Redux | HTML5 | CSS  

• Implemented user, product, and shopping cart CRUD features through an integrated customized database using Active Record and PostgreSQL for greater reliability and stability
• Linked Rails backend to AWS S3 for image storage and management to reduce server load and allow scalability
• Created custom search filters for easier navigation and product lookup to enhance user experience
• Built higher order components with React-Router and encrypted user credentials using BCrypt for a secure and seamless user authentication interface
• Achieved user autonomy by linking user’s products to their account allowing efficient product editing and deletion

projects.title: MoneyTree
projects.description:
A data visualization application of average Software Engineer salaries across popular metropolitan cities in the United States.

Javascript | HTML5 | CSS | D3.js

• Incorporated custom movement, gravity, and object collision to provide a physics engine that allows bubbles in the application to interact with each other
• Implemented DOM manipulation via D3 selections to create an alluring seamless experience for users to retrieve information
• Designed a custom filter in Javascript that classifies each bubble by city for easier data access and increased data visibility
